source_caption_text:
N3on gifted former NBA player Delonte West a fully paid-for Maserati to celebrate his progress in sobriety ❤️🙏

West has spoken publicly about reaching 100 days sober, and N3on has said he’s been living in sober housing and continuing to work toward a better path. The car is a meaningful gesture, especially after West’s difficult years since leaving the NBA.

N3on has also helped set West up with streaming equipment and a verified, monetized Kick account, giving him the option to share his story and build something new if he chooses. Wishing Delonte continued strength and support moving forward ❤️

Via; @n3onsingh
